title: Full Chain of Custody
description: Every tray and bin is tracked from pickup to delivery to office return, with a driver, route, and timestamp attached to each step.

title: Photo-Verified Handoffs
description: Pickup and delivery are both documented with timestamped photos, removing ambiguity about condition or contents at every stop.

title: Exportable Audit Trails
description: Route history, movement logs, and delivery times are available on demand for internal review or regulatory audit.

title: Structured Incident Tracking
description: Wrong facility, wrong quantity, damage, closure, or delay — every exception is logged, timestamped, and tracked to resolution.

title: Access-Controlled Records
description: Custody records are retained on a defined schedule and accessible only to authorized facility and compliance contacts.

title: Verified Driver Identity
description: Every action in the system is tied to a logged-in, identity-verified driver — no anonymous handoffs.
